prose.text: Building a daily short-pick report per picker so shift leads can target retraining and reduce errors.
Sam manually builds a report in Excel from WMS exports, taking about four hours every Monday.
Automate the report to show short picks per picker, per shift, per day, ready by 6am Monday.
Do not include over picks or customer/pricing data; cancelled lines are excluded.
If the report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, Sam will switch it off and revert to manual reporting.

acceptance.given: WMS pick confirmations are available and the report is generated automatically
acceptance.when: the report is delivered by 6am Monday showing short picks per picker, per shift, per day
acceptance.then: shift leads can use it to select pickers for retraining

acceptance.given: The report disagrees with WMS pick confirmations for two consecutive weeks
acceptance.then: Sam switches off the automated report and returns to manual Excel reporting

guardrails.text: If the numbers in the new report disagreed with the WMS two weeks in a row I'd switch it off and go back to my spreadsheet.
Manual Excel reporting from WMS exports is the fallback if the automated report fails.
